part3_runtime.map_pose_information: current online poses only; no final BA map used to make decisions

selected_method.insertion_location: E1: Initializer initial map scale; B: LocalMapping low-parallax point insertion
selected_method.conflict_policy: Keep triangulated points; B fills only rejected low-parallax matches passing existing map checks
selected_method.metric_scale_semantics: E1 initialises in network metres; B estimates recent metres per map unit from triangulated correspondences; subsequent optimisation can change points and scale
selected_method.random_seed_support: upstream backend has no validated deterministic seed; five independent processes
selected_method.selection_rationale: B80E1 is the combined Part 3 method, chosen before own-sequence scoring to exercise both scale initialisation and low-parallax depth insertion. It has lower median KITTI Sim3 ATE than mono in the uploaded batch; no universal best configuration is claimed. Own DAV2 base indoor differs from any unverified teammate model size.
